scope: City finale: clean painted anime materials, shared textures and corrected mapping

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square SEAMLESS TILEABLE game ALBEDO texture, filling the entire image edge to edge, orthographic flat surface with ZERO perspective. Art direction: clean hand-painted anime sci-fi city environment, restrained cool palette, simple broad graphic material shapes, subtle brush variation and neatly painted edges, consistent with polished low-poly cel-shaded art. It must be a practical repeating material, not an illustration of an object, not a 3D preview, not a texture sample on a wall. No labels, no borders around the image, no watermark, no cast shadows, no dramatic lighting, no photography, no noisy gritty microdetail. Opposite edges match seamlessly. SURFACE: pale cool grey precast concrete slabs. Four broad offset rectangular panels, thin cool grey recessed joints, tiny restrained corner chips, a few large soft brush patches of muted grey-blue. Mostly light grey, not white, material stays readable at speed. No exposed aggregate, no graffiti, no weeds, no pipes, no stripes. Edges of the tile must join to a continuing panel grid.
